newsitem.title: BULGARIA: YIELDS RISE ON BULGARIA 1-, 4-WK DISCOUNT T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: YIELDS RISE ON BULGARIA 1-, 4-WK DISCOUNT T-BILLS.

text.p: Yields rose on Tuesday at the
daily auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and
four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures show.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 0.46
and 3.77 percent, respectively, up from 0.41 and 3.71 percent
at Monday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 51.057 billion lev worth
of T-bills as the two issues were oversubscribed but the
ministry approved bids only up to the limit of its total offer
of 36 billion levs worth.
The issues were offered with par values of eight billion
levs and 28 billion levs, respectively and no minimum
acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
